query: How many biological and technical replicates per condition are needed to robustly estimate bootstrap LOD/LLOQ and kinetic rates for artifact mapping (propose n for calibrators and QCs)?

response.query: How many biological and technical replicates per condition are needed to robustly estimate bootstrap LOD/LLOQ and kinetic rates for artifact mapping (propose n for calibrators and QCs)?
response.answer: For robust estimation, use at least 6 biological replicates and 3 technical replicates per condition, including calibrators and QCs. Ensure sufficient calibration and quality control samples for accurate artifact mapping.
